prompts.redpanda:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent watercolor game animation sprite atlas, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 16 separate complete full-body poses, equal square cells, natural clean alpha transparency.
Input image: identity reference of the ONE baby animal to animate. Preserve this exact individual's face, coat colors, markings, body proportions, fur texture, short muzzle, eyes, ears, and tail identity. Do not redesign the character.
Primary request: create one 4x4 animation atlas showing this SAME animal in sixteen distinct ordered frames, facing toward the RIGHT in front three-quarter view, same camera, fixed scale, shared feet-ground anchor, full ears/paws/tail visible. Paint the whole animal bodily changing pose, not detached overlays. Keep each subject separated by clear transparent gutters and safely inside its equal grid cell. Each frame must contain exactly one contiguous full-body animal.
Style: gentle detailed children's-book watercolor and gouache, soft tactile fluffy fur and subtly painted edges, matching the supplied reference. Warm cute baby expression while retaining real animal anatomy.
Frame order, left to right each row:
ROW 1 frames 0-3 EATING: (0) sitting alert mouth closes, (1) gently bows head toward its front paws and mouth opens to nibble, (2) slightly lower head munching with rounded cheeks and eyes half closed, (3) lifts head back to sit with a satisfied closed-mouth little smile. Visible head, jaw, shoulders and forepaws motion. No separate food objects.
ROW 2 frames 4-7 CELEBRATING: (4) sitting happy beginning to raise its right forepaw, (5) raises forepaw up beside face in a joyful wave, mouth small smile, (6) forepaw reaches its highest natural point and eyes gently close in delight, (7) lowers paw back toward ground, returns near sitting baseline. Keep hindquarters on same feet-ground point.
ROW 3 frames 8-11 AFFECTION: (8) normal soft-eyed sit, (9) tilts head a little toward viewer and leans its cheek forward, (10) slightly deeper affectionate lean with both eyes peacefully closed, (11) eases head back a little while still eyes closed and content. Actual neck/head/shoulder deformation, not whole-body sliding.
ROW 4 frames 12-15 STRETCH AND RECOVER: (12) begins reaching both forepaws forward, (13) true gentle cat-like quadruped stretch with forepaws grounded forward, chest low and hindquarters lifted, (14) rises through all-four-paws relaxed stance, (15) returns to the original seated pose.
Constraints: consistent same individual and body mass in every cell, no skipped or duplicated cells, no left-facing frame, no extra limbs, no clothing or accessories, no text/numbers/grid lines, no landscape, no floor, no cast shadow, no halo, no decorations, no hearts/sparkles, no disconnected objects, genuine fully transparent background. All figures with same paw baseline within every cell and 12% margin around ears and tail.
Animal-specific invariants: this is a red panda, not a raccoon or orange bear. Preserve warm rusty cinnamon-red head/back/tail, cream-white cheek mask and inner ears, dark chocolate almost-black chest/belly/legs, short pointed rounded ears, reddish tear marks, fluffy tail with rusty-red and pale buff rings, and sweet brown eyes as in reference. Tail curves toward its right behind the hindquarters and remains attached.
